I got bored and finally made a website

REV A · 2 MIN READ

Eighty-nine repositories. Four hundred stars. Twenty-odd years of shipping Java that other people’s builds quietly depend on. The only thing on the internet with my name on it was a GitHub profile and a WordPress blog whose password I genuinely do not remember.

So: here is a website. I got bored, which is historically how all of my projects begin. Thanks Claude for this cool layout. Now I just have to do the hard part and actually write content.
